C: B2 [ C ] UK US zipper a device consisting of two rows of metal or plastic teeth-like parts that are brought together by pulling a small sliding piece over them, used for closing openings in clothing, bags, etc.

I or T: › [ I or T ] to fasten something with a zip

I or T, usually + adv/prep: › [ I or T,  usually + adv/prep ] informal to move or go somewhere very quickly

T: › [ T ] to compress (= reduce the size of) a computer file so that it uses less space, and can be more easily sent or stored

example: to do up/undo a zip
拉上／拉開拉鏈
I can't open my bag - the zip has stuck.
我的袋子打不開——拉鏈卡住了。
The new engine has given the car a lot more zip.
新引擎使這輛汽車加速不少。
I know zip about computers.
我對電腦一無所知。
The Dolphins are leading the Giants fourteen to zip (= by fourteen points to nothing).
海豚隊以14比0領先巨人隊。
This bag's too full, I can't zip it shut.
這袋子裝得太滿，拉鏈都拉不上了。
This dress zips (up) at the back.
這件連衣裙的拉鏈在背部。
Zip your coat up, it's cold outside.
把外套的拉鏈拉上，外面很冷。
I'm just going to zip over to the shops - I won't be long.
我就去商店轉一圈——時間不會很長的。
We were about to cross the road when a car suddenly zipped past.
我們正準備過馬路，這時一輛汽車突然飛馳而過。
Zip the files before you email them.
先壓縮文件，然後再用電子郵件寄出。

NONE: › in the US, a series of numbers that forms part of an address, used to help organize post so that it can be delivered more quickly

example: See also
postcode

NONE: › a brand name for a part of a computer used for copying large documents onto special disks
極碟磁碟機（用於將較大文檔複製到磁碟上的電腦驅動器）
› a computer file that has been compressed (= reduced in size) so that it uses up less space
› a rude and angry way of telling someone to stop talking

example: Just zip it - I'm tired of listening to you complain.
住嘴——我聽夠你抱怨了。

NONE: › to fasten a piece of clothing by using its zip, or to help someone close the zip on a piece of clothing they are wearing
拉上…的拉鏈；幫（某人）拉上拉鏈

example: Could you zip me up, please?
請幫我拉上拉鏈，好嗎？
Zip up your jacket, it's cold out there.
把上衣的拉鏈拉上，外面很冷。

NONE: › a long thick wire attached between two points, one higher than the other, that you can move along quickly while hanging from a small wheel, as entertainment or as a way of travelling above and across something
高空滑索，高空飛索，單索滑降

example: Activities include archery, zip wire, and abseiling.
活動包括射箭、單索滑降和繞繩下降。
The elevated zip line will take guests on a 50-mph ride across the forest canopy.
架高的鋼索將讓遊客以每小時50英里的速度飛越森林的樹冠層。
